cases.name: new choice fields persist the same two presets already shown by their controls
reading old choice fields with missing or empty options never creates current write-command presets
editing either placement shares single and multi options with the canonical field and other placements
subtable options update canonical columns and embedded placements across pages without touching another table
model option edits update every placement while preserving compatible widget configuration
renaming an option label preserves its existing value identity and former immutable document
one choice edit is one complete undo step and round-trips model and canvas consistently
the existing row factory saves a configured single-select default as the actual canonical option value
unrelated binding and widget edits do not adopt a saved inconsistent placement or reactivate disabled options
rebinding a compatible choice control takes its new field options without carrying another field option list

scopeLimit: Baseline replay substitutes original store and field registry using Git original bytes, with current regression assertions; it is not a full old-tree suite.
